flowable.database: PostgreSQL (Testcontainers postgres:17-alpine, server 17.11, fresh database per engine instance)
flowable.historyLevel: AUDIT (Flowable default; the adapter does not set it)
engineConfigurationAsUsed: adapter as installed: async executor off (timers via executeDueJobs), DMN and CMMN configurators, history level not set by the adapter (engine default)
the engine clock is per engine configuration (shared by the DMN/CMMN engines)

scenarios.title: Re-appropriation from a savings head: availability, competent authority (DMN), concurrence, sanction, idempotent IFMS posting
featuresUsed: external task posting with operationId and lease re-delivery

productLayer.what: budget ledger and posting idempotency (operationId set) in the product layer

scenarios.title: Challan / receipt reconciliation by file exchange (PFMS SFTP simulator) with polling external work, exceptions to a user task
featuresUsed: external task writing the outbound file
external task polling the inbound status file (fail with retry back-off until the file arrives)
non-interrupting boundary timer PT2H on the polling task (overdue file)

productLayer.what: file transfer, polling and matching are product workers; the engine only sequences them (no native file / SFTP connector is used on either engine)

scenarios.title: Monthly pension bill generation by timer start cycle, approval, IFMS payment per pensioner
notes: Changing the monthly cycle of a timer start event needs a redeployment (the timer belongs to the definition); the month is taken from the run date by the product worker (timer starts carry no variables)

scenarios.title: Tender: NIT -> corrigendum extends running deadline -> bids (incl. early) -> technical committee all-sign -> time-locked financial opening -> L1 negotiation loop -> LoA -> EMD refund to losers by compensation
featuresUsed: event-based gateway loop (bid message / corrigendum message / deadline timer)
timer timeDate ${bidDeadline} re-armed with the corrigendum date
parallel multi-instance external task (EMD hold per bidder) with compensation boundary
parallel multi-instance user task, humanPerformer per member (all sign)
variants: flowable:exclusive="false" on the parallel multi-instance EMD external task

workarounds.what: product inbox for bids that arrive before the NIT is published (engines do not buffer messages)

productLayer.what: bid register in the product layer: each bid message carries the running bidder list and count

failures:
EMD refund by compensation: throwing compensation after the LoA failed (org.apache.ibatis.exceptions.PersistenceException: 
### Error updating database.  Cause: org.postgresql.util.PSQLException: ERROR: update or delete on table "a); every step before the LoA passed
notes: Without flowable:exclusive="false" a parallel multi-instance external-worker task cannot be fetched: acquiring its exclusive jobs of one process instance returned 0 of 3 (native ManagementService.createExternalWorkerJobAcquireBuilder() returns 0 as well) and leaves them locked

scenarios.title: Works: estimate -> AA -> TS -> tender stub -> work order -> measurement -> 3 monthly RA bills (cycle timer) -> final bill -> completion
featuresUsed: embedded sub-process with non-interrupting boundary timer cycle R3/P1M
parallel tokens (RA bills outside the execution sub-process)
